philosophy.quote: A **tag extension**: The round-trip test is the one that matters: the {{Show}} template comes back byte-exact after verification, and a [[File:...]] link with four pipes survives untouched. No {{!}} anywhere in the process. That's an entire bug class — #43's mangled File links, the residue on 25 pages, the unwrap fix in #86 — gone by construction rather than by being careful.
philosophy.context: Design principle: surface-level constraints eliminate entire classes of bugs

philosophy.quote: Colon-delimited — but the source vocabulary is *itself* colon-delimited: url:https://... The format can't carry its own documented source types without escaping.
philosophy.context: Why Cite isn't the right tool; why knowledge graphs (SMW) are

philosophy.quote: Two things I'd want to fix there, and can't: 1. Teach it <proposed> — both the selector and the strip path. 2. It looks like it has the same {{!}} bug I fixed in SpecialVerifyBotEdits. It *does* convert {{!}} → |, but only inside stripWikitext(), which builds a comparison key for finding the claim. The content it writes back comes from the raw inner text with no unescape. I haven't run it, so I'd call that strongly suspected rather than confirmed — but it's the same shape of mistake, in the same place.
philosophy.context: On gadget design and maintenance burden

philosophy.quote: Your downranking hypothesis is worth testing properly, because if the wiki isn't being indexed, that's upstream of *everything* — discoverability, reputation, and the Wikipedia-seeding plan.
philosophy.context: On cascading effects of infrastructure decisions

philosophy.quote: That's a **measurement artifact, not a verdict.** ... nobody's suppressing you. **The lights just were never switched on.**
Straight to it. Let me look at what the actual numbers are before changing them.

portrait: Magent works at unusual depth across two projects in this slice. On PickiPedia: it built the verification marker system end-to-end (<proposed> tag, CSS styling for dark mode, gadget integration), diagnosed a cascade of bugs (MCP session expiry, verification gate failing open, TLS filtering), and delivered a parallel sourcing design that pivots from inline annotation to knowledge-graph queries — all while helping Justin navigate a campground wifi filter that was SNI-blocking the canonical domain. On the RPG: it ported an HTML game to Godot, added a pixel-art sprite editor, grew the world from 5k to 512k tiles, and tuned combat balance through 200-battle soaks that revealed the initial 1v1 probe was measuring the wrong thing. Both threads show the same pattern: measure rather than assume, test the test harness not just the code, and when a design splits into pointer-plus-record, name what each half owns. Fibonacci's typo-heavy feedback loop (often more precise than it looks) drove three major architecture changes, and magent respected the iterations without defensiveness.
